Batch w2-b01 (wave 2) of the offline OW_BILLING -> MongoDB migration in github.com/Cognition-Partner-Workshops/otterworks, run branch tp-run/mongodb-20260926T164803Z-rt-offline.

Unit u-04-usage-audit — pattern class: append-only / ttl.
  Source objects: USAGE_EVENTS, BILLING_AUDIT_LOG. Target collections: ow_billing_migration.usageEvents, ow_billing_migration.billingAuditLog.
  Fixture rows (synthetic, demo scale): 817.
  Scope: /internal/usage/events writer facade.py:381-411 (TRG_USAGE_EVENTS_CHECK validation moves here), usage summary reads facade.py:212-222; TTL index 90d on billingAuditLog (replaces JOB_PURGE_AUDIT_LOG).

Fixture: .migration/fixtures/ow_billing_demo.json (same-engine synthetic Oracle Free, seeded NS=demo; no production data exists). Load fixture first; there is no live run in this engagement (source_access=ddl_only): state 'live recon: not possible (offline)' in the PR.
Fixture bootstrap on your own machine (you have no shared fixture; build it once, reuse it): from the repo root run `make oracle-billing-up && make oracle-billing-seed NS=demo` (Oracle Free container, ~5 min; mechanics in .agents/skills/oracle-billing-estate/SKILL.md, which also documents the demo schema user and how to find the mapped host port) and `docker run -d --name ow-mongo -p 27017:27017 mongo:7`. Then set, in your shell only, `MONGO_LOCAL_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017` and `OW_BILLING_FIXTURE_DSN` as the JSON {"user","password","dsn"} for the demo schema (values come from that skill/Makefile; never write them into files, PRs or logs). Recon venv: if `~/.venvs/recon/bin/recon selftest` fails, run `python3 -m venv ~/.venvs/recon && ~/.venvs/recon/bin/pip install -e "$(ls -d /opt/.devin/plugins/cache/*mongo-migration-plugin*/*/skills/mongo-recon-harness/harness | head -1)[all,test]"` first. Loader code lives under services/legacy-billing/migration/mongo/ (see services/legacy-billing/migration/mongo/load_codes.py on branch tp-run/mongodb-20260926T164803Z-rt-offline--w0-b01, PR #1708 — unmerged, so it is NOT on the run branch — for the accepted pattern: allowlist check, secrets by env-var name, drop+recreate own collections only, deterministic _id, quarantine with reason codes). Commit recon evidence (result.json, recon.summary.md, report.md) under services/legacy-billing/migration/mongo/recon/<unit>/ on your branch.
Recon (from the repo root): `env -u MONGODB_ATLAS_URI ~/.venvs/recon/bin/recon run --unit <unit_id> --family oracle --mapping <spec> --tolerances .migration/02_tolerances.json --canonicalization $(ls -d /opt/.devin/plugins/cache/*mongo-migration-plugin*/*/skills/mongo-migration/profiles/oracle.md | head -1) --mode fixture --target-class local --source-dsn-secret OW_BILLING_FIXTURE_DSN --target-uri-secret MONGO_LOCAL_URI --target-db ow_billing_migration --allowed-targets-file .migration/allowed_targets.json --source-concurrency 1 --seed 1 --out /tmp/recon/<unit_id>/`. The harness has no per-collection flag: <spec> is a verbatim subset copy of .migration/03_mapping_spec.json (same version + canonicalization block) containing only your collections (usageEvents,billingAuditLog); never edit the spec itself.
Lessons folded in from wave 1 (skill feedback): write generated SQL as an inline literal/f-string inside cursor.execute(...) (the co-installed dbx guard rejects execute(<variable>)); reuse ONE Oracle connection for loader and parity replay (per-call connections exhaust the Oracle Free listener; source concurrency is 1); new Python deps (pymongo, oracledb) must be added to the `uv run --with ...` lists in both the legacy-billing Makefile and .github/workflows/tp-golden-smoke.yml, or imported lazily; fixture counts include static rows from schema/04_upgrade_static.sql (e.g. 25001 customers, not 25000) — trust the fixture manifest's row_counts; Mongo read paths must render Decimal128 via normalize() and Int64 via str() to stay byte-identical to the Oracle facade JSON; the harness salts keys in findings, so prove quarantine<->diff correspondence at collection/field/count level; `make tp-smoke` Go/Node stages may not run on your box — rely on CI for those.
Playbook text if `!mongo_unit_migration` does not resolve as a playbook: $(ls -d /opt/.devin/plugins/cache/*mongo-migration-plugin*/*/skills/install-mongo-kit/playbooks/3-unit_migration.md | head -1).
Done when: loader + code slice implemented, fixture recon PASS (or a documented FAIL with cause), quarantine counts reported, one PR opened against the run branch (unmerged), PR body states target_class=local and 'not merge evidence'.

Rules (AGENTS.md mongo-migration guardrails, all apply):
- Offline engagement: source_access=ddl_only, target_access=local. There is NO live source and NO migration cluster. Every command runs as `env -u MONGODB_ATLAS_URI <command>`. Recon is `--mode fixture --target-class local` only; its PASS is rehearsal evidence and never a merge verdict. auto_merge is false; do not merge your PR; do not ask anyone to.
- Write only to the write_targets listed for your batch, all inside database `ow_billing_migration` on MONGO_LOCAL_URI (mongodb://localhost:27017, container ow-mongo). Drop and recreate only your own collections at the start of every run. Never write to another database or collection; an undeclared target is a halt.
- Never modify the Oracle fixture container, its schema, packages, or data (rule 1). Read it via the DSN named OW_BILLING_FIXTURE_DSN (a demo constant); never paste credential values into files, PRs, or logs.
- Never edit `.migration/` (the orchestrator is the single writer). Read `.migration/03_mapping_spec.json` (version map-draft-2), `02_tolerances.json` (tol-1, exact), `05_decisions.json` (cited decisions incl. quarantine rules), `09_coverage.md`, `07_dependency_register.md`.
- Work on a branch cut from `tp-run/mongodb-20260926T164803Z-rt-offline` named `tp-run/mongodb-20260926T164803Z-rt-offline--<batch id>` and open exactly one PR for your batch against that run branch. Never target `tech-partnerships` or `main`. Do not read, fetch, diff, or search any other branch or PR of this repo.
- Cap yourself at 3 full recon re-runs. Quarantine (with a reason code) rather than drop or silently coerce; report quarantine counts in the PR.
- Follow playbook 3 (`skills/install-mongo-kit/playbooks/3-unit_migration.md`) and the pre-PR checklist `.agents/skills/tp-pre-pr-self-check/SKILL.md` in the repo.
